legs.rationale: Market prices DR Congo's knockout win at 7.7% implied probability, but model assigns 17% given England's right-back injuries, their 0-0 struggle against Ghana's low block, and DR Congo's counter-attack threat through Wissa.

slips.rationale: DR Congo at 13.00 offers genuine value against a market overconfident in England; the 9.3% edge reflects England's proven vulnerability to defensive blocks and exposed right flank.
